question: Which form of the goddess is invoked for protection in the syllable ka?
premises: Protection is sought in the syllable ka.
She is the consort of Hara.
inference: Śarvāṇī, the consort of Hara, is invoked to protect in the syllable ka.
plain_english: In the syllable ka, may the goddess Śarvāṇī, the wife of Hara, protect me.
